description: GDPR data retention rollout: implement automated deletion pipelines for user data that exceeds retention limits. Must: classify data types by retention period (active user: indefinite, deleted user: 30 days, analytics: 24 months), build deletion pipelines for each data store (PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, S3), configure audit logging for all deletions, set up archive lifecycle policies, and verify retention rules are enforced. Risk factors: deleting data still needed for legal hold, deletion pipeline failing silently, audit log incomplete for compliance. Tools available: aws CLI, Lambda, S3, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch.
